description: Largest exporting or importing countries for a commodity in a year, ranked by value, each with the implied unit value it realised. Use for 'who are the biggest cocoa exporters' and 'which sourcing market is cheapest'. EXPORTS ARE NOT PRODUCTION: a country can be a large exporter of something it does not grow — the Netherlands ranks sixth in cocoa exports and grows none. Completeness cannot be verified for this shape, so `complete` is always null.

commodity.description: Instrument code with an HS heading. Example: CC for cocoa.

flow.description: export ranks exporters, import ranks importers.

name: trade.ranking

complete.description: Always null here: the upstream publishes no aggregate over all reporters to reconcile against

notes.description: Caveats the numbers cannot carry. Read these before presenting a unit value.

reporter_count.description: Reporters the upstream returned, before any limit

reporters.description: Countries, highest value first. Ranked by this service, not by the upstream, which returns rows ordered by country code.

unit_value_catalog.description: The same figure in the instrument's own catalog unit, or null when there is no honest mass conversion (crude, gas and the grains price by volume or count).

unit_value_usd_per_kg.description: Average realised price implied by this row (value / net weight). NOT a benchmark or spot price — it reflects the grades and terms that actually traded, and will differ from price.latest. Comparable across the rows of one response only.

title: Countries Ranked by Trade
